title: Amelia NDE 3611
content: I had a perforated ulcer, with a lot of bleeding. My husband took me to hospital. Until then I was relatively conscious. I was taken to the operating theatre, where I only remember hearing 'She has no pulse, no pressure, we're losing her.' I didn't think this could be about me, as I was ascending a tunnel with a wonderful golden light at the end. I felt extraordinarily happy and a feeling of unforgettable well-being. I don't know when I came to again. What intrigues me is that after a month or two, already completely restored to health, I sometimes saw a young man (40, more or less) in my house, looking at me. I never saw his face, and he neither said anything nor made any movement. This happened on and off for about 5 months. Now, for the last couple of days, I have dreamed about this person in my sleep, helping me in dangerous situations, holding me tight. I even feel his arm assisting me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I heard the doctors say 'we're losing her'.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin

elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I began to see a person at times, when I was alone in the house - a young man, dressed in shirt and pants, looking at me in the same room, but not close to me.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It surprised me not to think there was anything mystical.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I thought it was the lack of oxygen resulting from death.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I believe I died, I don't know why.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I would love to know why this experience is now coming back to me so much.
